# Fixture for tests/render.rs: oscillator -> gain -> stereo master.
# The expected output is analytic: sample n = osc_amp * gain * sin(2*pi*osc_freq*n/sample_rate),
# evaluated in f64, identical on both master channels. Tolerance is -90 dBFS.
sample_rate = 48000
frames = 96000
osc_freq = 1000.0
osc_amp = 0.8
gain = 0.5
